cf_problems_problemset_identity_unique.name: cf_problems_problemset_identity_unique
cf_problems_problemset_identity_unique.where: "cf_problems"."contest_id" IS NULL AND "cf_problems"."problemset_name" IS NOT NULL

cf_problems_identity_check.name: cf_problems_identity_check
cf_problems_identity_check.value: "cf_problems"."contest_id" IS NOT NULL OR "cf_problems"."problemset_name" IS NOT NULL

codeforces_accounts_verification_timesta.name: codeforces_accounts_verification_timestamps_check
codeforces_accounts_verification_timesta.value: ("codeforces_accounts"."verification_status" = 'UNVERIFIED' AND "codeforces_accounts"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "codeforces_accounts"."reward_eligible_from" IS NULL) OR ("codeforces_accounts"."verification_status" <> 'UNVERIFIED' AND "codeforces_accounts"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "codeforces_accounts"."reward_eligible_from" IS NOT NULL)

codeforces_accounts_rating_check.name: codeforces_accounts_rating_check
codeforces_accounts_rating_check.value: ("codeforces_accounts"."current_rating" IS NULL OR "codeforces_accounts"."current_rating" >= 0) AND ("codeforces_accounts"."max_rating" IS NULL OR "codeforces_accounts"."max_rating" >= 0)

organization_memberships_left_at_check.name: organization_memberships_left_at_check
organization_memberships_left_at_check.value: ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'LEFT' AND "organization_memberships"."left_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("organization_memberships"."status" <> 'LEFT' AND "organization_memberships"."left_at" IS NULL)

point_transactions_earn_source_check.name: point_transactions_earn_source_check
point_transactions_earn_source_check.value: "point_transactions"."type" <> 'EARN' OR ("point_transactions"."source_submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "point_transactions"."scoring_policy_version" IS NOT NULL AND "point_transactions"."cc_level_before" IS NOT NULL AND "point_transactions"."problem_rating_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

point_transactions_correction_link_check.name: point_transactions_correction_link_check
point_transactions_correction_link_check.value: "point_transactions"."type" NOT IN ('REVERSAL', 'REFUND') OR "point_transactions"."related_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
